Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty and forty-five only when at least five bins are open, with a strong mid penalty of forty. This combines the best gate with the firmest push away from awkward gaps, but the strong penalty may hurt genuinely tight fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (40 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
